Grow a Farm is a farming and dungeon RPG on Solana, with progression that starts in the fields and continues beyond them. Players plant seeds, grow and harvest crops, and adapt as the weather changes. Crops can develop mutations, while seeds can grow into weapons for the challenges ahead.

Farming feeds the rest of the game. Players can use $SEED for in-game purchases and trade rare items through the marketplace, giving valuable discoveries a role beyond the farm. The goal is to keep improving your farm, find better crops and equipment, and prepare for what waits past each gate.

Seven dungeon gates lead beyond the fields, each giving players another challenge to work toward. Grow a Farm brings together farming, collecting, item trading, and dungeon progression in one game.
